# Counting Bits.

@example 0 to 7 are 0, 1, 10, 11, 100, 101, 110 and 111 in binary.

=> [0,1,1,2,1,2,2,3]

@example 8 = 1000 has a single 1, while 9 = 1001 and 10 = 1010 have two each.

=> [0,1,1,2,1,2,2,3,1,2,2]

@example Just the count for 0, which has no 1s.

=> [0]

=> [0,1]
